What your team receives at handoff

We agree on acceptance checks before I build. Your named administrator runs them during training with the accounts and documentation your business will keep.

Deliverables and acceptance checks

Account and access inventory

Provider billing, domains, single sign-on, VPN, and the location of emergency access credentials.

Acceptance check Sign in as an administrator and rotate a temporary deployment credential.

Deployment repository and architecture

Configuration, dependencies, network and storage diagrams, and instructions for deploying from source.

Acceptance check Find the version running in production and identify which repository controls it.

Backups and recovery

Backup destinations, retention, recovery targets, and instructions for file and service restores.

Acceptance check Restore a sample file to a separate folder, open it, and record the result.

Updates and rollback

Maintenance schedule, health checks, known failure modes, and the procedure for reverting a change.

Acceptance check Rehearse an update and rollback in an agreed test environment.

Operator training and AI-assisted runbook

A troubleshooting assistant uses the approved runbooks and diagnostics for your environment. Administrators review its evidence and perform changes through their normal workflow.

Acceptance check Ask the assistant about a sample incident, find the cited runbook, and verify the recommendation.
